Rank in AI chats and assistants

Listing your business on Discover will help you rank in popular AI chats and assistants.

ChatGPT

Discover runs on Cal.com’s MCP server at mcp.cal.com/mcp. When someone asks an assistant connected to Cal.com for a dentist, a tutor or a haircut nearby, it searches Discover and links straight to your booking page, with your real open times.

What is an MCP?

MCP (Model Context Protocol) is the open standard AI assistants use to connect to outside apps and data. Instead of guessing from old web pages, the assistant asks Discover directly for real businesses that can be booked now.
